title: Universal injectivity detected on finitely presented tensor tests
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $u:M\to N$ be an $R$-linear map. The map $u$ is universally injective (that is, for every $R$-module $Q$, the map $Q\otimes_R M\to Q\otimes_R N$ is injective) if and only if for every finitely presented $R$-module $Q$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] the map $Q\otimes_R M\to Q\otimes_R N$ is injective. If $R$ is Noetherian, it is equivalent to require this only for finite $R$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Tensor products have the meaning of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product].

source.place: Tag 058K, Theorem universally-exact-criteria, parts (1) and (2), with the Noetherian finite-module/finitely-presented equivalence

proof.text: If $u$ is universally injective, its defining condition holds for every $R$-module, hence for every finitely presented $R$-module. This proves the forward implication.

source.place: Tag 058K, theorem-universally-exact-criteria, (1) implies (2): restriction of the class of test modules.

proof.text: For the reverse implication, suppose that $\mathrm{id}_P\otimes u$ is injective for every finitely presented $R$-module $P$. Fix an arbitrary $R$-module $Q$. Apply [lem-trf-module-directed-colimit-fp] to write $Q$ as a colimit of a small nonempty directed system $(Q_i,a_{ij})$ with finitely presented stages and colimit maps $a_i:Q_i\to Q$. Thus every map $\mathrm{id}_{Q_i}\otimes u$ is injective by the hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 00HA, lemma-module-colimit-fp, applied to the arbitrary test module Q.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-commutes-with-colimits], the maps $a_i\otimes1_M$ exhibit $Q\otimes_R M$ as the colimit of the modules $Q_i\otimes_R M$; likewise $a_i\otimes1_N$ exhibit $Q\otimes_R N$ as the colimit of $Q_i\otimes_R N$. These are colimits over the same small directed set from Step 2.

source.place: Tag 00DD, lemma-tensor-products-commute-with-limits, including its assertion identifying the colimit maps.

proof.text: Let $x\in Q\otimes_R M$ satisfy $(\mathrm{id}_Q\otimes u)(x)=0$. By [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise] applied to the first colimit in Step 3, write $x=(a_i\otimes1_M)(x_i)$ for some $x_i\in Q_i\otimes_R M$. Set $y_i=(\mathrm{id}_{Q_i}\otimes u)(x_i)$. The maps $(\mathrm{id}_Q\otimes u)(a_i\otimes1_M)$ and $(a_i\otimes1_N)(\mathrm{id}_{Q_i}\otimes u)$ agree: both send $q_i\otimes m$ to $a_i(q_i)\otimes u(m)$, and pure tensors generate by [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Hence $y_i$ maps to zero in the second colimit. The vanishing assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise] gives $j\ge i$ with $(a_{ij}\otimes1_N)(y_i)=0$. The same pure-tensor computation gives $(\mathrm{id}_{Q_j}\otimes u)((a_{ij}\otimes1_M)(x_i))=0$. Since $Q_j$ is finitely presented, the test hypothesis implies $(a_{ij}\otimes1_M)(x_i)=0$. Applying $a_j\otimes1_M$ yields $x=0$, since $a_j a_{ij}=a_i$ and the induced tensor maps compose, again by [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. The kernel is zero, so $\mathrm{id}_Q\otimes u$ is injective. As $Q$ was arbitrary, $u$ is universally injective.

source.place: Tags 00D6 and 00D7, lemma-directed-colimit and lemma-zero-directed-limit: a representative becomes zero at a later stage; naturality is checked here on pure tensors.

proof.text: Finally suppose $R$ is Noetherian. By [lem-sc-noetherian-finite-module-finite-presentation], every finite $R$-module is finitely presented. Conversely, in a presentation $R^m\to R^n\to P\to0$ as in [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], the images of the $n$ standard basis vectors generate $P$, because the map $R^n\to P$ is surjective. Thus $P$ is finite in the sense of [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Consequently the finite and finitely presented test modules form the same class over $R$, so the equivalence already proved gives exactly the stated Noetherian variant.

source.place: Tag 00FP, lemma-Noetherian-finite-type-is-finite-presentation, part (1); the reverse implication is the finite generating set in the definition of a finite presentation.

proof_origin.place: Direct filtered-colimit proof of the injectivity criterion of Tag 058K (1) iff (2), using Tags 00HA, 00DD, 00D6, 00D7; Tag 00FP (1) for the Noetherian variant.
